body.p: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.

section.title: Project Review Tasks
section.p: Project Review Tasks are created from content in projects. They are part of the project workflow. Accepted changes can be integrated back into the project content. All users with the user role Author who have access to a project can see all review tasks that were created in that project.
At the end of the review process, task owners can integrate the review task changes into the project as part of the project review task workflow.

section.title: Independent Review Tasks
section.p: Independent Review Tasks are not tied to a project. They can be created from or from supported desktop tools. Any follow-up integration is handled outside the review task workflow.

To create independent review tasks from desktop tools, install the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on. It integrates into Oxygen XML Editor and Oxygen XML Author. This allows users to create independent review tasks directly from those desktop tools and integrate proposed changes back into the original content source. For more information, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.

p.note: Only the task owners and the reviewers who are granted access to the task can see and access that task.
